title: Tag vulnerable Amazon ECR images
description: An Amazon Inspector finding on a vulnerable Amazon ECR image triggers an AWS Step Functions workflow via Amazon EventBridge to tag the image and alert via Amazon SNS.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern tags a vulnerable container image as soon as Amazon Inspector raises a HIGH or CRITICAL finding on it. The tag is a marker only: it doesn't stop anyone pulling or deploying the image.

An Amazon Inspector finding on an Amazon ECR container image is routed by an Amazon EventBridge rule (source aws.inspector2, detail-type Inspector2 Finding, filtered to ACTIVE HIGH/CRITICAL findings on images in the demo repository) to an AWS Step Functions STANDARD workflow.

The workflow reads the image manifest by digest with `ecr:BatchGetImage` and writes the same manifest back under a per-image `quarantine-<digest>` tag with `ecr:PutImage` - a pure control-plane re-tag that needs no AWS Lambda function - then publishes an Amazon SNS notification. Retry and Catch drive a failure-notification path, and repeat findings for an already tagged image end without another email.
